report.explanation: Gateway telemetry is largely healthy (error_rate 0.001, p95 71ms, INFO 200 logs, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters), yet one gateway trace shows an ERROR calling inventory at 945ms. Current evidence is insufficient to attribute a root cause: no downstream service telemetry is available. Operator hypotheses are not established; hand off for downstream evidence.
